name: Implement and debug low-level network socket code
description: Users asked to write, debug, or explain code for implementing low-level network communication protocols, such as TCP, UDP, SCTP, and raw sockets. Requests often involved specific tasks like packet crafting, handling non-blocking I/O, configuring socket options, or implementing client-server applications in languages including Python, C, C++, and Java.
